title.content_goal: Plain board title with period, scope, and decision context.
title.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Title must name the deck object, not a generic category.
Subtitle should lock scope or use context.

comparison.content_goal: Plan vs actual columns with variance driver notes.
comparison.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Verdict must be visible on the slide.

chart.content_goal: Facts-right chart with target/actual callout and source footnote.
chart.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Chart needs a written readout, not only bars/lines.

table.content_goal: Compact sortable-style table, zebra bands, and bold exception rows.
table.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Split or summarize if table text would fall below body-size floor.

figure.content_goal: Generated figure with adjacent numbered readout, never floating alone.
data_roles: figure path or generated output id
figure.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Figure must be source-backed or synthetic/starter-labeled.
Caption and interpretation must remain readable.

dashboard.content_goal: KPI strip across top, chart/table detail below, decision band at bottom.
dashboard.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Use dashboard only when multiple metrics earn one slide.
Every metric needs a label and context.

decision.content_goal: Action table: decision, metric trigger, owner, date.
decision.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Decision slide must make the action inspectable.
Avoid generic next-step prose without owner or trigger.

references.content_goal: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
references.source_posture: Source-line footer with data cut/version; appendix table for long source notes.
authoring_checks: Move long citations to editable references tables.
